subject: Private VPC pricing & environment count — follow-up
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-01T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up & next steps after today's call

Hi Emma — great to meet you and the FintechCo team on the call today. Thanks for the context on your use case (real-time AML scoring and post-transaction customer support summaries). Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the key open items so we can align on pricing and architecture next week:

- Token volumes: you mentioned a pilot of ~10M tokens/month with potential to scale to 100-200M tokens/month in 12 months. Please confirm typical prompt lengths (avg input / avg output).
- Environments: you asked about separate environments for prod + staging + analytics — looks like 3 environments is the typical ask.
- Licensing model: Redwood Private supports per-instance licensing + a committed reserved capacity/throughput component; we also offer enterprise perpetual + annual support tiers.
- Target unit economics: you called out a target of ~$100- $200 per 1M tokens for total delivered price (including support & reserved capacity).

Attached is a short pricing summary and SLA options we referenced. For next steps I propose:
1) You confirm avg prompt/output lengths and whether the pilot will route production traffic.
2) We prepare a preliminary quote (licensing + 3 envs + Standard support) and an optional higher-support tier for comparison.
3) Quick sync with Procurement if you'd like to review commercial terms (we can include Marissa on that).

Would you be available for a 30-min follow-up next Tuesday or Wednesday?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-private-pricing-summary.pdf, SLA-options.xlsx

From: Emma Li <emma.li@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps after today's call

Thanks Ben — recap looks perfect. A few clarifications:

- Token volumes: Pilot will start at roughly 8-12M tokens/month. If pilot goes well we expect ramp to ~120M tokens/month over 9-12 months. Peak month projections account for batch post-processing (higher output tokens).
- Prompt lengths: avg input ~220 tokens, avg output ~380 tokens (helper model + summarizer).
- Environments: yes — prod, staging, analytics (3). We may add a sandbox for dev later but not in pilot.
- Budget range: our procurement team gave a target committed spend of $40k- $80k/month for the pilot phase (covers license + reserved capacity + support). For steady-state at 120M tokens/month the finance team is targeting <$1500 per 1M tokens effective all-in.

Procurement is looped on this thread (procurement@fintechco.com) — they will want a compact .pdf quote and a high-level SLA summary.

Emma
Emma Li
Head of Product, FintechCo
emma.li@fintechco.com
